claim.quote: A total of 163.5 excess events were detected, with a statistical significance of 8.5 sigma.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published in Mon. Not. R. Astron. Soc. (DOI in the publication field).

name: Detection of the Crab Nebula with the first TAIGA IACT

official_url.quote: Detection of the Crab Nebula using a Random Forest Analysis of the first TAIGA IACT Data

significance.quote: with a statistical significance of 8.5 sigma

summary.plain: The first imaging telescope of TAIGA, analysed with a random-forest classifier, detected the Crab Nebula above 6 TeV in 85 hours of data, an 8.5 standard-deviation signal that validates the hybrid detector's first telescope.
summary.technical: Random-forest gamma/hadron separation on 85 h of first-IACT data at mean zenith 33.5 degrees, threshold 6 TeV; 163.5 excess events at 8.5 sigma; power-law spectrum above 6 TeV with index -2.74 ± 0.16.

title: Detection of the Crab Nebula using a Random Forest Analysis of the first TAIGA IACT Data
why_it_matters: The abstract states the analysis tracked the Crab Nebula for 85 hours and detected a significant signal with the first TAIGA IACT, a step toward the hybrid HiSCORE-plus-IACT technique aimed at PeV gamma rays.
